messages: Rowan: dropped a small design pass on traffic handoff, legend, and visual hierarchy for the rollout timeline: https://figma.com/file/special123 (frames 'Handoff flow' + 'Legend v1') Cass: nice work. immediate thing i noticed: the timeline uses 4 visual cues (color, pill, icon, opacity) to signal status. feels heavy. can we reduce to 2 strong cues + an accessible label? my vote: color + label (and optional icon) with a consistent shape for pills. Marta: accessibility nits: color alone won't work. add a visible text label like 'active', 'paused', 'failed' inside the pill and include a visually-hidden status phrase for screen readers (e.g., 'active'). also verify contrast for the 'paused' gray — currently 4.2:1 on body text but the pill is small; bump to 4.5:1 for readability. Devon: microcopy: the handoff step currently says 'Handoff to service' which is vague. suggest 'Route remaining traffic to stable' or for partial handoffs 'Route additional X% to stable'. Also in the legend include short examples: 'Active 11 11 (running canary)', 'Stable (production)'. keeps things clear for new users. Kai: keyboard and focus: each legend item should be focusable and toggleable to filter the timeline (space/enter to toggle). add aria-pressed on legend chips and an aria-label that includes count (e.g., 'Active deployments, 2 items'). Rowan: decision proposal: simplify visual cues (color + label), ensure pill contrast >= 4.5:1, add sr-only status, legend chips are interactive with aria-pressed + counts, and update copy for handoff text. also keep a subtle icon for quick scanning but not required. Marta: graphs in the detail panel: they currently have tiny tooltip triggers. for keyboard, show an accessible table fallback (aria-hidden toggled) when 'Open metrics' is focused and allow 'T' to toggle table view. tooltips should have role='tooltip' and be accessible via focus. Cass: visual hierarchy note: the active lane should have a slightly elevated card (1px shadow) rather than a heavy border so it reads as foreground. but for reduced-motion, don't animate elevation on hover; just apply static elevation. Devon: routing micro-interaction: when a user drags the canary slider to adjust percent, we show a live preview in the header 'Will route X% to vY'. ensure this preview is announced for screen readers (aria-live='polite') but debounce to 400ms to avoid too much chatter while dragging. also ensure Enter commits the change and Escape cancels. Kai: legend copy: include keyboard hint in a tooltip 'Press space to toggle'. update the keyboard shortcuts modal. Also when a legend filter is applied, announce 'Showing only active deployments' via aria-live polite. Rowan: final recap: simplify to color+label (with sr-only), bump contrast to >=4.5:1, interactive legend chips with aria-pressed and counts, active lane elevation not heavy border, metrics fallback table + 'T' toggle, slider preview announced with 400ms debounce, copy updates for handoff phrasing, keyboard hints in tooltips. i'll update figma and add annotations, please review. Marta: small follow-up: for colorblind support add a patterned underline for the active pill (SVG pattern) as a non-color hint. Rowan: good idea — will add. Kai, can you run a quick screen-reader smoke test after i push frames? Kai: yep, will run once frames are live. deploy-bot: ui-legend-handoff-1768077 logged by Rowan at 2026-03-18T16:12:57Z (design notes saved).
